entities.summary: Kathleen McGowan is an American author. Born Kathleen Harkey-Smith, her first book was Tragic Kingdom: Inside Michael Eisner’s Disney. As Kathleen McGowan, her novel The Expected One sold over a million copies worldwide and has appeared in over fifty languages. She claims to be a descendant of Jesus Christ and Mary Magdalene.
